nodes.name: Technical Tick 10 Minutes
nodes.notes: Technical wake-up only. Business schedule is read from CONFIG_LICH through WF01.

parameters.jsCode: const input = $input.first()?.json ?? {}; const envelope = input.envelope ?? {}; const executionId = typeof $execution !== 'undefined' && $execution.id ? $execution.id : String(Date.now()); return [{json: { envelope: { request_id: envelope.request_id || 'dispatch-' + executionId, operation_id: envelope.operation_id || 'dispatch-' + executionId, event_type: 'SCHEDULED_JOB', actor_user_id: 'SYSTEM', branch_id: null, business_date: null, config_version: null, payload: { intent: 'READ_STATUS', required_sheet_names: ['CONFIG_LICH', 'CONFIG_GLOBAL', 'CONFIG_BRANCH', 'CONFIG_THONG_BAO'] } } }}];

nodes.name: Call Config Gateway
nodes.notes: Requests CONFIG_LICH and receives the immutable config_snapshot_id.

nodes.name: Call Error Handler
nodes.notes: Critical and recovery notices use configured safe messages and Error Handler audit/notification policy.

nodes.name: Call Error Handler - Dispatch Notice
nodes.notes: Inactive branches, active sessions, and missed grace windows use the configured dispatcher destination.

nodes.name: Verify persisted dispatch claim
nodes.notes: A worker runs only when the read-back row still belongs to this execution token.

nodes.name: Execute Configured Worker
nodes.notes: Worker workflow ID comes from CONFIG_LICH; this node does not select a business worker by hard-coded schedule.

nodes.name: Call Error Handler - Worker Failure
nodes.notes: All configured worker failures are normalized and audited by WF02.
